name: papercusp-signups
description: Read captured papercusp.com access requests from Cloudflare KV through the host connector driver. Produces source-cited person records; signup is neither verified identity nor communication consent. Fixture verified only.
author: Papercusp

credentials.label: Cloudflare KV read token
credentials.help: Use a token restricted to read the signup KV namespace in the selected Cloudflare account. The host stores it and injects the bearer; the adapter never receives it. Selecting a record destination is separate from connecting.
